title: How do I measure on the map?

content.text: Click the ruler in the menu at the bottom right. Choose whether you want to measure a line or an area. Click once to create a corner point. Double-click to finish.

title: Can I delete individual objects when drawing?

content.text: Yes. In the drawing tool, you can select and delete individual objects.

items: Click the mouse pointer button in the top right of the drawing tool.
Click the object you want to delete.
When the object becomes dashed or gets a black outline, it is selected.
Click the trash can icon to delete the object.

title: How do I view an elevation profile?

content.text: The elevation profile tool is available under “Create map” in the main menu.

items: Click a starting point in the map.
Click where you want the measurement to end.

title: Drawing storage

content.text: When you save a drawing, it is stored for 2 years on Kartverket's servers. Anyone with the link can view the drawing. To delete drawings, contact post@kartverket.no

title: How do I edit my drawing?

content.text: Click the mouse pointer button inside the drawing tool. To edit an object, click the object you want to change. When the object is selected, you can change its color, size, or shape by dragging the object.

title: Which search criteria are supported in the search field?

content.text: In addition to place names, roads and addresses, you can search using combinations of municipality name/number and property identifiers.

title: How do I search for coordinates?

content.text: The search field supports several coordinate formats.
Geographic coordinates:
UTM coordinates:

If the coordinate values are larger than 180 (which would normally indicate degrees), the search engine assumes UTM33 coordinates, which is the default coordinate system used in the map, for example: 487560,7442215.
You can also specify the coordinate system using an EPSG code, for example: 306461.46,6885442.27@EPSG:25832.

title: I get many similar place names, but I can't find the right place

content.text: Enter the name of the place you are looking for. As you type, the map will update with markers. You can zoom in on the relevant location. If you know which municipality the place is in, you can narrow down the search by adding a comma (,) followed by the municipality name.

title: Where can I find property information?

content.text: In Norgeskart you can view property boundaries and basic property information.

items: Click on a property in the map.
A result panel will appear in the upper-right corner.
Select “Property information” to view municipality number, farm number and usage number.
Click “Show on map” to highlight the property boundary.
Click “Show more” to open additional details in the Property Register.

title: How do I share a map view?

items: A unique URL will be generated automatically.
The link contains your current map view and can be shared with others.

title: How do I share a map with drawings?

content.text: To include drawings when sharing the map, you must first save the drawing.

items: Click the save icon at the bottom of the drawing menu.
A unique URL will be generated.
Share the map using “Share” in the menu or copy the URL from the search field.

title: Can I print in formats other than A4?

content.text: The map can be printed in both A3 and A4 formats.

title: How do I change the basemap?

content.text: Click the map icon in the bottom-right corner. Here you can choose between different basemaps.

title: Can I find my location?

content.text: Yes, you can. Click the location icon in the side menu in the bottom-right corner. You will then be taken to your current location.

title: Is there a legend for the map layers?

content.text: Unfortunately, there is currently no good interactive legend for the basemaps. We will work to make this available in the future. When a thematic map is activated, you can display the legend by clicking «Legend» in the bottom-right corner. On mobile, you can activate the legend by clicking the info icon in the side menu.

title: How often is the map updated?

content.text: The update frequency depends on the selected basemap or which thematic maps are activated. The standard map is updated weekly, while the thematic layers are updated at different intervals.

title: How do I activate full screen mode?

content.text: The toolbar in the lower-right corner of the map includes several functions such as zoom, rotation, location and full screen mode.

title: Hide the menu with the keyboard

content.text: You can hide and show the menu by pressing the 'U' key on your keyboard.

title: Can I change the scale?

content.text: If you are using a PC or tablet, you can select the desired scale along the green bar at the bottom of the page. The selected scale is adjusted to the nearest available zoom level on the map. The actual scale may therefore differ slightly.

title: Is it possible to view old aerial photographs?

content.text: This is not currently possible in Norgeskart.  Kartverkets solution
Norge i bilder
offers this option. Here, you can also compare different aerial photographs using a swipe function.

title: Can I turn different map layers on and off?

content.text: The basemap itself is made up of image tiles and is therefore static. You can add thematic data by selecting «layers» from the menu.

title: Where can I find property information?

content.text: Under thematic maps, you can find property-related themes that can be added to the map. Clicking on the map will open an information box. Click «Property information» for details about the property. If you want more details, you can click «View more» to be taken directly to the Property Register.

title: What do the different boundary colours mean?

items: Dark green = Moderately accurate and transformed measurements (S>10 and S<=30 cm)
Dark purple = Less accurate measurements and boundaries (S>30 and S)
Light purple = Less accurate boundaries (S>=200 and S)
Orange = Low-accuracy boundaries (S>=500 cm, except «freehand drawing»)
Red = Sketch boundaries with no stated accuracy (S>=500 and «freehand drawing», or no accuracy stated)

title: Can I report an error concerning my property?

content.text: If you believe that a property boundary is shown incorrectly on the map, you must contact the local cadastral authority. This means the municipality where the property is located. Kartverket does not have the authority to make changes to property boundaries.

title: What does cadastral register mean?

content.text: The cadastral register is the official register of properties in Norway. It contains public information about boundaries, buildings, addresses and ownership.

title: What does land parcel mean?

content.text: A land parcel is a contiguous area defined by parcel boundaries. In the cadastral register (property register), a single cadastral unit/property can consist of one or more land parcels. If parts of the same property are separated from each other, they are registered as separate land parcels.
